note: Which policies each document describes, and how. The citation on each route is its scope: the narrowest range of the document that supports the attribution (a schedule row, a 'primary carrier' section, or the whole document when the whole document is the policy). Only passages inside a scope are admitted to the passes, decided in code. Hand-labelled from the filing. Documents not listed (coda_end12, both Chubb binders, ERMA) name no primary. Only identifications of FD960228 are recorded so far.
